TEXT: The next day, Saori and I went to Yokohama.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: The wind feels nice today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

Spending peaceful time together, just the two of 
us.

We're at a western-style building filled with exotic 
atmosphere situated on top of a hill, the breeze 
brought in the smell of the shore.
It truly was a elegant day off.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: There is also a rose garden over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh yeah? Let's go take a look later then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I reserved a restaurant in Chinatown, so let us have 
lunch there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whoa... That's really thoughtful of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Fufufu.

Yesterday was an exciting date at Akiba with Saori 
Bajeena.

Today is an elegant stroll around a park with Lady 
Saori.

That big difference can get a bit unsettling, but it's 
not bad when you get used to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Around here is where Kirino and everyone went to 
invade your house.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Oh yeah, that happened. That was certainly 
surprising.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We're the ones who are surprised. We had guns 
pointed at us without warning.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That was because my maiden secret was exposed.

Maiden secret = spending her off days playing 
survival games in cosplay, alone.

Now that I've understood Saori's past, that was an 
absurd and lonely way to kill time.

I can see why she wanted to protect that secret 
back then.

Yes, at that time she had sunglasses and 
camouflaged clothes on, talking like a man.
And introduced herself in front of us -

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I am called Makishima Kaori.

She was imitating her older sister's crude tone of 
speech.
Saori's sister, "Kaori-san," must be like that.
Vivacious, heroic, and cool.

It appears Saori has some complicated feelings 
about her.
I hope I can meet her, someday.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Um... Kyousuke-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Aren't we... going to hold hands?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Are you okay with that?

It wasn't too long ago when she said she'd die of 
embarrassment if she held hands.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I don't really know if I am...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But it's not as embarrassing as the swimsuit...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [font_size=28]P-Please don't imagine it![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not, I'm not!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay then. Let's hold hands?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-How is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: As I thought, it's embarrassing.
Even so, she did not panic about like before.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Gotten used to it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, it does seem that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Looks like the swimsuit was quite effective.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
G-Geez... Kyousuke-san. But still... it was probably 
thanks to that.

It was a fortunate error for Saori, but there was 
nothing but profit for me.
That was a wonderful event indeed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wanna go to the beach again?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Sure thing? Next time I'm going to wear a one 
piece swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's necessary to wear a bikini to conquer your 
shyness. You understand, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
No matter how serious you are, the answer is no. I 
will not fall for that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Dang.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
To make up for it though, I have various fun events 
planned just for today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Please look forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay.

This reliable side of her is the same as "Saori 
Bajeena".

Making plans for everybody, taking a step back, and 
enjoying the fun times with everyone.
But guess what, Saori.
As lovers, you can't just do that, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Then, I'll work hard to get you to have fun too. Look 
forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Aren't dates supposed like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hmm, Kyousuke-san, it must be due to that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Aren't you a little too used to dates with Kiririn-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really?
Huh? Our opinions don't match.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Thank you for being considerate. But...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I'm the host today, so please, just sit back and 
enjoy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But, if I leave it as it is, you'll even end up paying 
for everything!

I'm the older guy, I can't just let my girlfriend pay 
for everything on the date!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
That's not true at all. You paid for our date 
yesterday, right? How manly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Sure, but only at Akiba. In fact, didn't you pay for 
everything on the date at the beach?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Oh my, did I really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't play dumb. It was a private beach with a car 
escort, along with someone who looked like a butler 
bringing all the food and drinks.
There was no opportunity for me to pay at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: So that bothered you, did it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I did that on my own accord, so that doesn't count, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: As if I'd let you off like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I know I couldn't simply pay for something on that 
level, but it still bothers me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You are such a sensitive guy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, that sarcastic remark was way too natural for 
you!

It's nice she opened her heart, but coming out was 
unexpectedly a Lady Saori possessing a wicked 
tongue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I bet today's lunch is gonna be so extravagant that 
I won't be able to afford it anyway, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
It is a place famous for its delicious Peking duck. 
I'm sure it will satisfy you.
I knew it.

Sure, I'm really looking forward to it. I'm glad she 
went to that extent, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I'm really uneasy about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
In this aspect, you and your sister are not at all 
alike.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: If it's Kiririn-shi she would say-

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: For real~? Can I really? Thank you~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't put me together with that girl with diamonds 
for nerves.

She thinks of herself as an existence that deserves 
to be treated all the time is why.

If she was in my situation, getting many things from 
her lover-

She would just be ecstatic and accept it all 
without hesitation.

That in itself might be a good thing though, being 
completely ignorant and all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm the type of guy who wants to give back to his 
girlfriend after receiving.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So for the next few dates, let's have something 
more plebeian.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ―― I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
But, I have already made the reservations for 
today, so please give up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Next time, we'll have an plebeian date.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry about that. I am really thankful.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Not at all, I should be sorry, getting so carried 
away.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I anticipated these dates with you so much that I 
ended up going slightly overboard.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ah, are you embarrassed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I'm not embarrassed!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...S-Shall we go?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes.
Saori reservedly held onto my hand tightly.

I... held back tightly while being conscious about my 
flustered face.
